core.headline: Extended 1930s semi-detached house in Sevenoaks
core.listing:
This four-bedroom semi-detached house in Oak Lane combines 1930s character with contemporary family space created by a 2021 rear extension and a 2019 loft conversion. The property retains its original stained-glass front door and hall window.

The sitting room measures 4.55m x 3.70m into bay (14'11" x 12'2" into bay) and features a log burner. The dining room measures 3.60m x 3.40m (11'10" x 11'2"). The kitchen/family room, added in 2021, measures 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) and is fitted with an island, bi-fold doors to the garden and underfloor heating. A ground-floor shower room and utility occupy the former garage.

The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10"). Bedroom four, in the loft conversion completed in 2019 with building regulations approval, measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max) and has an en-suite. A family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approximately 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Sevenoaks station is approximately 0.8 miles away, with trains to London Bridge taking approximately 25 minutes. Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains. Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. FTTP broadband up to 900Mbps. Good indoor and outdoor mobile signal. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
